proof_roadmap: Annihilation reduces to primes over the ideal (proof lines 8393-8397).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the equations presenting a relative global complete intersection over a ring form a Koszul regular sequence. The proof uses that the Koszul homology groups are annihilated by the ideal generated by the equations, so it suffices to check that their localisations vanish at every prime containing that ideal; at such a prime the conormal description of the relative global complete intersection identifies the situation with that of a regular sequence, and regularity implies Koszul regularity by the standard comparison.
